title: check_typed_item_calls.py: Add a check for all-zeroes mask
description:
When the mask value is 0x0, it effectively means there is no
mask, or that all bits count.  So when multiple zeros are included,
this is confusing/misleading, e.g. 0x0000

Fix found instances and replace them with 0x0.
